name: Maasai Mara & Amboseli
about: Long dry season Jun–Oct brings the migration river crossings; Palearctic migrant birds arrive Nov–Mar.
overview: Kenya's two classic safari circuits — the Maasai Mara's Great Migration river crossings and Amboseli's elephant herds beneath Kilimanjaro.
costOverview: Kenya's parks charge some of Africa's highest entry fees, and the real cost driver is the camp or lodge tier that bundles guide, vehicle, and game drives — Amboseli runs a notch cheaper than the Mara.

specialSeasons.text: This is peak Great Migration season, with wildebeest herds making dramatic Mara River crossings.

monthlyWeather: warm and mostly dry, with clear morning views of Kilimanjaro over Amboseli
